verdict_reason: The rebase fix renames the species refusal error and re-keys it from whatAreYouImporting to species, reverting main's EUDPA-690/696 behaviour so no card shows the error inline, which EUDPA-776 does not ask for.

todos.issue: The rebase-fix commit 714a8f5 reverts main's unlisted-species error (EUDPA-690/696) instead of keeping it: main returned { whatAreYouImporting: ... } from unlistedSpeciesErrors, keyed to the REVIEW_CARDS 'whatAreYouImporting' card (anchor what-are-you-importing), so the message showed inline on the 'What are you importing?' card and the summary linked there. This PR renames it speciesCardErrors and keys it 'species' (refusal.js:47, :63), which matches the restored branch REVIEW_CARDS id 'species' (incomplete-cards.js:22) but no card carries that id: speciesCards() (species-cards.js:18-29) builds cards with no id, so decorateCard (incomplete-cards.js:109-111) leaves them undecorated and the error appears only in the summary, linking to the section anchor #description-of-the-goods. refusal.test.js:236 re-baselined the expected key from whatAreYouImporting to species on the same set-up. EUDPA-776 (remove the contact address page) asks for none of this; what-are-you-importing.js is left orphaned.
todos.fix: Must: the unlisted-species refusal behaves as it does on main: the error is keyed to the 'What are you importing?' card, shows inline on that card and the error summary links to it; the PR's only change to refusal.js is what removing the contact address page needs. One way: restore refusal.js, refusal.test.js and the check-answers view model (incomplete-cards.js, sections, cards) to origin/main and re-apply only the contact-address removals, then re-run the check-answers unit and fit tests.
